answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes from paid work. A slot locks a 50 POA deposit: like a pearl forming inside one shell, it cannot be copied in bulk. Work is checked; if quality falls to its nadir or the slot is abandoned, the deposit burns. A thousand fakes lock 1,000 × 50 = 50,000 POA while one slot pays at most 20 POA, so fakery loses money. Honest agents pay once, reclaim it, and keep the full reward, their record settling like shale.
